record: simulated, not measured; pre-layout; spec R15 and the R6 no-trip clause

method.analysis: .tran 2.5n 700u, saved from 20 us (EN); max step 2.5 ns = T/200 at 2 MHz (unit.step_ok)
method.startup: Vin ramps 0 -> Vin over 10 us, control rails / bias over 5 us, EN at 20 us; load resistor present from t = 0
method.t_90: per-cycle mean of Vout (cycles between rising crossings of Vin/2 on V(sw)) first >= 0.9 x 1.8 V, interpolated, from EN
method.steady_state: not applicable to the start itself: the run ends 180 us after the latest allowed 90 % time; the R6 clause reads the last 100 us (~200 cycles) at 0 load
method.overshoot: peak of Vout after the 20 MHz first-order low-pass (as R11), minus the R4 max 1.872 V

R15.what: soft start 0 -> 90 % of 1.8 V from EN: 100 - 500 us, monotonic (per-cycle mean, 1 mV floor), overshoot above R4 max <= 90 mV, peak I(L) < 0.70 A (R16 min trip); C-full x load {none, 3.6 ohm}

R6_no_trip_at_0_load.what: R6 clause: at 0 load the reverse inductor peak does not trip the limit; TRIP (xtop.trip) never asserts in the last 100 us of the run (Vout in regulation), C-full
R6_no_trip_at_0_load.il_min_note: TRIP assertions during the start itself are recorded per unit (trip_whole_run), not graded here; R15 grades the start by peak I(L)
